name: MúzaPay
author: Benefit Plus

sections.description:
With this plugin, you can pay for your order in the shopping cart of an e-shop using benefit points. It is an innovative payment gateway that offers quick and convenient payments using a QR code. After completing the order, the payment gateway generates a QR code which you scan with your phone and pay through the MúzaPay application.

Plugin Features:

  • Speed and Convenience: MúzaPay allows instant payments using a QR code. The customer shopping on the e-shop selects MúzaPay for payment. After completing the order, you are redirected to the payment gateway which displays the QR code. The customer scans it with their mobile banking application, confirms the payment, and the transaction is completed instantly.
  • Reduced Costs: QR payments reduce payment processing costs for sellers. Since these are account-to-account payments, sellers do not have to pay credit card fees.
  • Security and Reliability: Instant QR payments are secure and minimize the risk of erroneous payments. The buyer only needs to scan the QR code, eliminating the need for manual data entry.
  • Improved Customer Experience: Buyers do not need to carry cash or credit cards. They usually have their mobile phone with them, making payments more convenient and quicker. This can lead to higher sales for sellers.
  • Wide Availability: QR codes are easy to use and can be used on various types of devices, including mobile phones, tablets, and POS systems.
  • Contactless Payments: QR payments are contactless, minimizing physical contact between people.
  • Transaction Tracking: Sellers can easily track payments and analyze customer purchasing behavior.

MúzaPay offers a modern and efficient way of payment that makes life easier for both customers and sellers.
